selected_primary_idea.title: Symmetry-Operational Photon-State Ledger for Separating Self-Conjugacy from Measurable State Opposites
selected_primary_idea.summary: A computational quantum-state protocol that tests whether an alleged photon opposite is self-equivalent, measurement-distinguishable, convention-dependent, or out of scope.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: One-photon density operators with helicity, direction, polarization, and structured-mode labels
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: Charge conjugation is operationally identity-equivalent in the self-conjugate one-photon sector, whereas selected state transformations become distinguishable only relative to a declared measurement context.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Apply declared symmetry/state transformations to synthetic photon density operators and evaluate invariant and observable-resolved distances.
falsifiers: C transformation yields an observable distinction in the standard one-photon model
